title: Rendering retained-model replay
scope: Bounded replay of actual retained DXF rendering inputs and bit-exact retained model/parser-state comparison against both real callback snapshots; independent physical property coverage and target/output semantics remain separate.

implementation.scope: Bounded replay of actual retained DXF rendering inputs and bit-exact retained model/parser-state comparison against both real callback snapshots; independent physical property coverage and target/output semantics remain separate.

sources.role: Autodesk primary DXF VISUALSTYLE field inventory
findings: Groups 62 and 63 are separate colors; 421 is face mono color. Preserve their separate roles and presence rather than mapping all into one existing native-shaped scalar.
The documented style property inventory is larger than the existing DXF description/type projection.

sources.role: Pinned independently implemented DXF VISUALSTYLE parser/writer source
findings: Separate 62/63/421 fields; the retained extension after group291 can reuse primary group codes.
store_acad_xdata removes the post291 tail before normal attribute decoding and later exports it separately. This is source-level architecture evidence, not an executed peer semantic oracle.

changes: Replay original typedRaw with captured source version, codec version, codepage, compatibility profile, text encoding and policy; use actual VisualStyle parseCode and shared RenderSettings decoder/finalizer.

Compare both actual typed/raw model snapshots, their original scoped parser state and pending XDATA masks/cursor indexes. Compare all retained VisualStyle body/encoding companions/colors and RenderSettings vectors/named fields/native opaque-state metadata.

Retained double equality preserves signed zero. Cursor comparison requires a corresponding owned extData variant index; storage-budget lease identities and logical accounting counters are not semantic value fields.
Retain a separate immutable replayed model/state in the sealed audit, bounded by separate replay byte/work admission, parser record/node/retained/work budgets and actual decode accounting.
Expose allocation-free RenderingModelReport.modeledStateMatched only for exact retained state. propertyCoverageMatched, originalSourcesMatched, ownerTargetsResolved and outputEligible stay false.

Explicit replay construction/decode failures invalidate model qualification even when an earlier sealed audit exists; original captured transport inputs remain available for corrected re-finalization.
No new model/facade data members or virtuals, native DWG byte-layout changes, resource family changes or output admission.

tests.allocationSchedule: Each profile enumerates offsets 0..255 in the actual replay helper, stopping after two consecutive unreached offsets; fault scope excludes unrelated import/legacy consumers. Corrected full finalization follows every offset.
tests.allDrawingInputs: runtime local literal recipes; no external drawing payload, conversion or derivative added

limits: Exact retained state replay is necessary but does not prove that every physical source property is typed, semantically represented or independently inventoried.

Full VisualStyle DXF property typing remains open. Existing description/type projection and opaque tail retention cannot establish full property coverage; native bodyDecoded semantics must not be reused indiscriminately.
Complete producer/version-qualified source spans, property/reference inventories, rooted original rendering targets, recursive/live/emitted closure and whole-document ownership remain open.
Finite reached allocation schedules are not exhaustive allocation coverage or controlled memory/performance qualification.
No peer parser execution, external fixture commit, native application/platform qualification, remote mutation or support promotion.
nextImplementation: Implement the documented VisualStyle primary properties with separate group62/group63/group421 roles and absent/zero/default metadata; preserve property-tail scope and old native model semantics.

Use ABI-safe structured publication metadata where existing native-shaped fields cannot represent independent source roles; share original and replay decoding while independently checking full physical property/subclass/reference spans.
Complete producer/version-qualified RenderSettings shapes and real NOD/named-dictionary/owner/active LAYOUT/VIEW/VIEWPORT target binding.
Continue background/live-section/sun, VIEWPORT and other producers, recursive/live/emitted/TABLE and full native/release/consumer/external qualification.
